name: Ciaran Mullooly - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the role of cohesion policy in supporting the just transition
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on how European regional aid should help areas hit by the shift away from coal, peat and heavy industry. It asks for special economic zones around closed plants, with faster planning decisions and tax breaks, and for money for retraining, apprenticeships and decent jobs. It wants simpler rules so local groups can apply, cheaper housing and energy upgrades, and a new fund after 2027. This is an opinion; it does not change law.

- The Parliament asks for special aid zones, training money and simpler rules; nothing changes yet.
- It affects workers and communities in coal, peat, industrial and island regions.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to the European Commission and member states.
